meta.name: hunt-cache-poison
meta.description: Hunting skill for cache poison vulnerabilities. Built from 10 public bug bounty reports including X-Forwarded-Host poisoning, X-HTTP-Method-Override / GCS cache, reflected→stored XSS via cache, classic Omer-Gil Web Cache Deception, Cloudflare Cache Deception Armor bypass, session-token cache deception, Akamai hop-by-hop smuggling → server-side edge poisoning, and Kettle's 2024 path-normalization WCD against Cloudflare/Fastly/GCP. Use when hunting cache poisoning, Web Cache Deception, CDN-fronted apps.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导你一步步测试网站缓存投毒漏洞，包括识别缓存层、发现未键控请求头、测试 Web 缓存欺骗、验证缓存存储等。
howto.when: 当你需要测试一个网站是否存在缓存投毒或 Web 缓存欺骗漏洞时，尤其是目标使用了 CDN（如 Cloudflare、Fastly、Akamai）时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个网站是否有缓存投毒漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会开始指导你进行缓存投毒测试。

say.text: 检查这个 URL 是否存在 Web 缓存欺骗。
say.note: Claude 会指导你附加假扩展名测试缓存。

say.text: 测试 X-Forwarded-Host 头是否被反射并缓存。
say.note: Claude 会指导你发送带该头的请求并检查反射。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you step-by-step to test for cache poisoning vulnerabilities, including identifying cache layers, discovering unkeyed headers, testing Web Cache Deception, and verifying cache storage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test a website for cache poisoning or Web Cache Deception vulnerabilities, especially if the target uses a CDN (e.g., Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai).

say_en.text: Help me test this website for cache poisoning.
say_en.note: Claude will start guiding you through cache poisoning tests.

say_en.text: Check this URL for Web Cache Deception.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to append fake extensions to test caching.

say_en.text: Test if X-Forwarded-Host header is reflected and cached.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to send a request with that header and check reflection.
